purpose: Identify HTTP responses missing browser security headers that reduce client-side attack resistance.
when_to_use: Baseline check on any authorized web application. Cheap and passive (risk 1); run it early in an engagement.
detection_approach: Fetch the target and compare response headers against a required-header list (Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Strict-Transport-Security, Referrer-Policy). Report the headers that are absent.

references.title: OWASP HTTP Security Headers Cheat Sheet
